system.description: By defeating the target in a Mental Challenge, this power allows you to recite a riddle of your choosing. The target can do nothing but try to solve it, although she may defend herself normally if attacked. The Riddle is so impenetrable it can damage the minds that think about it: the target must guess the answer once every 10 minutes, whether she knows it or not. For every incorrect guess she takes one nonaggravated wound, and every third incorrect guess results in an aggravated wound. Malkavians or Kindred with two or more Derangements are immune to this side effect. The duration is one night, or until completion of the riddle.
system.duration: One night or until riddle is solved
